model: TopTronic E heat generator via Hoval Modbus/BACnet gateway (standard datapoints)
equipment_type: Boiler / heat generator controller (via BACnet gateway)
applies_to: Hoval heat generators with TopTronic E controls (heat generator, up to 3 heating circuits and hot water) connected to BACnet through the Hoval Modbus-to-BACnet gateway (Intesis).
summary: Hoval publishes the default signal list for its TopTronic E BACnet gateway: an Intesis BACnet server polling the TopTronic E over Modbus RTU. The standard set has 54 objects: gateway comm-error BIs, outdoor, room, flow and hot water temperatures, heat generator values, writable comfort/eco/manual setpoints for three heating circuits and hot water, and operating-mode selections and status for each circuit.
notes: The file is an Intesis MAPS signals export (Modbus master to BACnet server) that Hoval publishes for its BACnet gateway; the mapping can be edited on site, so treat this as the factory default.
Object names are the Name column (German); descriptions here are English translations. WEZ = heat generator, HK = heating circuit, WW = domestic hot water.
Multistate objects have no state texts in the file, only the number of states.
Access: objects with a Modbus write function in the file are listed as W, the rest R.
Signal file exported with Intesis MAPS 1.2.25.0, timestamp 2025-08-12.
The file does not say whether the gateway serves BACnet IP or BACnet MS/TP; check the gateway configuration.

source.title: TTE ModBus BACnet Datapoints (Intesis MAPS signals file, sheet Signals)

integration.summary: Install the Hoval BACnet gateway on the TopTronic E Modbus bus and load the Hoval project in Intesis MAPS. Then write the operating mode and room setpoints per heating circuit and the hot water setpoints, and read temperatures and status.
setup: Built with Intesis MAPS; the Modbus side is RTU (Port A) to the TopTronic E gateway module.
gotchas: State texts for the mode and status MVs are not in the file; get them from the TopTronic E Modbus documentation.
Only one heat generator (WEZ 1) and three heating circuits are mapped by default.
